name: boulder
description: A boulder: one irregular, faceted block of weathered rock with a seeded outline, sitting on a flat bed in the ground, with a cushion of moss over its top and a few loose stones at its foot. The seed changes the whole shape, so a field of boulders never repeats; size, proportions, how jagged it is, how deep it is set, the moss and the stones are parameters.

params.name: length
params.description: Longest side in metres (a boulder is anything over 0.26 m).

params.name: width
params.description: Width as a share of the length.

params.name: height
params.description: Height as a share of the length.

params.name: jagged
params.description: How irregular and faceted the outline is (0 is a smooth, water-worn stone).

params.name: embed
params.description: How deep it is set in the ground, as a share of its half height.

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed for the shape and the stones.

params.name: moss
params.description: A cushion of moss on the top.

params.name: mossCover
params.description: How far down the sides the moss grows.
